result.topic_en: Calculations with series of the form $\sum e^{an^4+bn^3+cn^2+dn}$ and $\sum e^{an^3+bn^2+cn}$, their functional equations under shifts of the parameters, contour-integral (period) relations, and connections with theta functions, $\log\sin\mathrm{am}$ and the elliptic Zeta function under the shift $u\to u+2K'i$.
